documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30,2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Standalone And Consolidated Un-Audited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30 2026.

analysis.summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited presented its Q4 and H2 FY26 financial results, reporting full-year consolidated revenue of Rs. 326.15 crores, a 12% increase year-on-year. The company experienced robust revenue growth in the second half across its water technologies, construction chemicals, distribution, and cleaning segments. Management highlighted raw material price inflation in key metal inputs such as zinc and molybdenum, impacting margins by approximately 3% in recent months. Chembond enters FY27 with a strong order book and plans to deploy cash reserves to drive geographical expansion and network growth.

guidance.claim: The company foresees around 15 to 20% volume growth in construction chemicals in quarter one of the financial year.
guidance.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

guidance.claim: The company expects water chemicals volume growth to be roughly around 10% in quarter one.
guidance.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

demand_outlook.claim: Consolidated revenue for FY26 reached Rs. 326.15 crores, representing a 12% growth over the previous year.
demand_outlook.quote: Consolidated revenue for financial year 2026 at Rs. 326.15 crores. It is higher by 12% of last financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: In H2 FY26, revenues grew across all segments with water technologies up 36%, construction up 18%, distribution up 40%, and cleaning and hygiene up 15%.
demand_outlook.quote: Water technologies grew 36%, construction 18%, distribution 40%, and cleaning and hygiene 15%.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction chemicals volume increased by 30% in H2 FY26 over H1 FY26 to 2590 metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of volume, first half we were at 1988 metric ton of volume. It increased by 30%. So in second half we were at 2590 metric tons of volume.

capex_expansion.claim: CapEx reached around 21 crores due to the full-year impact of the demerger and office building renovation.
capex_expansion.quote: And of course, the office building, the improvements that we've done and the The entire renovation of the office building to house our teams, so that has taken up, but twenty-one crores, whole demerger, yeah, P.P.E. which has come into our books, so this is the demerger effect.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested ₹90.76 lakhs towards the installation of the 350 kVA solar plant at Dudhwada during FY 2025-26.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹90.76 lakhs were invested towards installation of the 350 kVA solar renewable energy plant at the Dudhwada, Gujarat manufacturing site during FY 2025-26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for FY26 reached Rs. 51 crores, up 7% over the prior year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the full financial year is at Rs.51 crores, up 7% over prior.

margins_costs.claim: For FY26, EBITDA margin was 14% of sales and profit after tax margin was 10% of sales.
margins_costs.quote: And in terms of percentage margin to sales, EBITDA is 14% of sales and profit after tax is 10% of sales.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs escalated from late February and March due to volatility in metal-based raw materials like zinc and molybdenum.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March. A lot of volatility in metals before that. So some key materials that we use are based on metals, so zinc and molybdenum and stuff like that. All of them had been tracking up.

margins_costs.claim: Management observed an immediate 3% margin impact due to higher raw material costs.
margins_costs.quote: But in the immediate month, we saw about a 3% impact on our margins due to these haywire costs.

orders_capacity.claim: Chembond is starting the financial year with a strong order book for its chemicals business.
orders_capacity.quote: So we are starting this financial year with a strong order book for our chemicals business also.

capital_allocation.claim: The company intends to deploy some of its cash balances into network growth and geographical expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: We intend to deploy some of it in network growth and geographical expansion.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 per equity share of ₹5 each, aggregating to ₹336.20 lakhs for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 (Rupee One and Paise Twenty-Five only) per equity share of ₹5 (Rupees Five only) each, aggregating to ₹336.20 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: About 30% of the water business comes from public sector units, none of which had accepted force majeure until two weeks prior.
risks_headwinds.quote: About 30 percent of our total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted a force majeure until the government just declared it two weeks ago.

management_commitments.claim: The company foresees around 15 to 20% volume growth in construction chemicals for quarter one.
management_commitments.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

management_commitments.claim: The company foresees roughly 10% volume growth in water chemicals in quarter one.
management_commitments.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
